decisions.title: Local-first LLM via Ollama
decisions.rationale: Privacy + zero API cost for development. Cloud fallback via AI_POLICY env var.

decisions.title: pgvector for embeddings
decisions.rationale: Avoid separate vector DB. PostgreSQL handles OLTP + vector search in one service.

decisions.title: LangChain ReAct agent
decisions.rationale: Tool-use pattern fits real estate Q&A. Reasoning trace is auditable.

decisions.title: WhatsApp Cloud API (Meta)
decisions.rationale: Primary channel for Argentine market. No third-party BSP cost.

decisions.title: XGBoost for lead scoring
decisions.rationale: Tabular data, interpretable via SHAP, fast inference, no GPU required.

decisions.title: Celery + Redis for task queue
decisions.rationale: Replaced by Supabase Edge Functions in Fase 8. No self-hosted worker needed.

decisions.title: Next.js 14 standalone Docker output
decisions.rationale: Replaced by Netlify deploy in Fase 8. No Docker for dashboard.

decisions.title: Meta-learning feedback loop
decisions.rationale: Continuous improvement of agent, matching, and ML scoring from real interactions.

decisions.title: Supabase as primary DB (replaces local PostgreSQL)
decisions.rationale: Cloud-hosted PostgreSQL with pgvector support. Admin can snapshot locally. Enables multi-tenant RLS natively.

decisions.title: Multi-tenant via agent_id scoping + RLS
decisions.rationale: Single DB instance. Privacy enforced at two layers: Supabase RLS (dashboard direct queries). Admin bypasses both.

decisions.title: Property catalog is public; owner contacts are private
decisions.rationale: All agents can search/match properties. Owner contact data visible only to listing agent. conversation_summary visible to all for context.

decisions.title: Cross-agent match: share client name + explanation only
decisions.rationale: Listing agent sees buyer name + match reason to enable coordination. No other buyer data exposed. Recorded in cross_agent_matches table.

decisions.title: WhatsApp numbers managed by admin, not self-registered
decisions.rationale: Admin controls onboarding. Each agent gets one phone_number_id enabled/disabled from admin panel.

decisions.title: Supabase Edge Functions replace Celery workers
decisions.rationale: Serverless Deno functions handle async matching + notifications. No Redis, no self-hosted workers, no Celery beat. Triggered by DB events or API calls.

decisions.title: Netlify for dashboard hosting
decisions.rationale: Next.js 14 on Netlify via @netlify/plugin-nextjs. Already paid plan. No Docker, no server management for frontend.
